title: Treatment syncs between master and follower (and viceversa)
symptom: Treatments created on one xDrip device (master or follower) do not appear on the other device, even though they appear in Nightscout. The other phone shows no IOB and no green curve.
cause: The issue is caused by a missing feature or bug in xDrip's treatment sync between master and follower devices, as the Nightscout follower option to download treatments is enabled but treatments from another xDrip are not being downloaded.
fix: As of the release on February 24, 2024, there is a new switch in the 'Upload Treatments' submenu titled 'Skip items from xDrip' enabled by default. Disabling this switch allows treatments uploaded by another xDrip to be downloaded.
evidence_quote: As of the release on February 24, 2024, there is a new switch in the "Upload Treatments" submenu titled "Skip items from xDrip" enabled by default. If you disable this switch, treatments uploaded by another xDrip will also be downloaded.
